info.title: Kareer Pathfinder AI Recommendation Engine API
info.description: Stateless, deterministic career-recommendation API. Frontend-agnostic: plain JSON over HTTP. No authentication, no database, no personal data stored. Scores are heuristic fit scores, not predictions of success. See docs/API.md for integration notes.

post.summary: Top career paths for a student profile
post.description: Deterministic: identical input and knowledge base give identical output. An empty profile is valid and returns status `insufficient_information` with HTTP 200.

post.summary: Personalised learning plan for one career
post.description: Built from the real roadmap records. The profile is optional; without it the plan starts at stage 1 with no access adjustments.

400.description: INVALID_JSON: the body is not valid JSON.

405.description: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED. The Allow header lists valid methods.

422.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: wrong types or out-of-range values. See error.details[].field.

503.description: KNOWLEDGE_BASE_UNAVAILABLE: the knowledge base failed to load.

interests.description: Topics the student is interested in (multi-select).

skillsToDevelop.description: Skills the student would like to develop. Kept separate from currentSkills.

goals.description: What the student hopes to achieve.

mathConfidence.description: Confidence in maths, 1 (low) to 5 (high). Numeric strings are accepted.

educationLevel.description: Accepted and echoed for the UI; not used in scoring.

budget.description: Learning budget. NEVER affects the fit score; shapes resource ordering and cost warnings only.

internet.description: Internet reliability. NEVER affects the fit score.

device.description: Device limits. NEVER affects the fit score.

weeklyHours.description: Study hours per week. NEVER affects the fit score; drives the pacing suggestion.

learningFormats.description: Preferred learning formats. Reorders resources; never removes any.

experienceByCareer.description: Optional: prior experience per career id, so a returning student can start further along.

StudentProfile.description: Every field is optional. A skipped question is treated as "not answered", never as lack of ability or interest. Unknown option ids and unknown fields are ignored with a warning; wrong types are rejected (422). Do not send personal information.

Fit.description: A heuristic fit between the answers and the career, NOT a probability of success. Show the label and disclaimer with the number.

weightPercent.description: Effective weight after renormalising over answered factors. Sums to 100 across evaluated factors.

contributionPoints.description: Points this factor adds. Contributions sum to fit.score (within rounding).

url.description: Copied from the knowledge base; null when none was supplied. Never constructed.

costNote.description: Always includes a verification caveat. Display it next to any cost hint.

verificationStatus.description: From the knowledge base. Every v0.7 resource is not independently verified.

safetyNote.description: Show it. Present on security projects (authorised testing only).

careerBasis.description: Knowledge-base evidence behind the career mapping.

status.description: ok: firm enough to show. exploratory: show as an early signal. insufficient_information: no ranking; ask the questions in missingInformation.

share.description: Percent of total factor weight the answers could support.

durationPerSource.description: Exactly as written by the source. Not a deadline or estimate.

prerequisitesPerSource.description: Free text from the source; not machine-checked.

activities.description: The stage's activities in source order. Their resources may have been introduced in an earlier stage (each resource is listed once per plan).

resources.description: Resources introduced in this stage, ordered for the student's access needs. Unique across the whole plan.

opportunityLeads.description: Leads only. status is always unverified_lead: never present one as open or funded.
